verdict.rationale: Parsec for Teams documents provisioning Team Computers that can be assigned to a single member or a group, which gives group-based access to machines. It also offers role-based admin roles and SCIM-based user provisioning, so machines and users are centrally organized with per-group access. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the shared admin console or address-book view itself, detail on what per-group policies can be configured beyond machine assignment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
